som.text: Koth's planeswalker spark ignites as the tribes of his people fall into open war over corrupted ore, and he purifies the ore, restoring the metal and slowing the skirmishes.
He brands the Phyrexian insignia on his arm as a promise to save his people, and when he meets Elspeth in the Urborg pits she tries to kill him on seeing the mark until Ajani stops her.
Enraged by Venser's carelessness, Koth traps his head in a stone mask to force him to planeswalk to Mirrodin, where Venser and Koth are captured and brought to the Phyrexian lair at Ish Sah.
Koth escapes by melting his manacles, Elspeth kills the Phyrexians and frees Venser, and the trio reaches the Mirran resistance led by Ezuri.

mbs.text: Koth sends partisans into the Tangle to bring survivors to the tunnels below Kuldotha as the Phyrexians besiege Mirrodin.
With Elspeth and Venser he frees Melira from Tezzeret, and Karn asks the group to lead the resistance with her.

Koth is later captured and forced to fight in Sheoldred's Coliseum, from which he escapes changed, and he sinks Elspeth into the ground and shields her from the spellbomb blast so that she can planeswalk away.

mat.text: Koth is one of the planeswalkers whose spark has faded, as Nissa's friends tell her in Zhalfir while she wonders whether she lost hers too.
Koth joins Karn, Kaya, Melira and Teferi Akosa in a ritual to un-compleat Ajani and Nissa, in which Melira dies and Karn loses his spark.
